# Step 1: Introduction to GitHub Copilot Custom Instructions

Welcome! Let's get started with GitHub Copilot and custom instructions.

## Your First Task
1. Install the GitHub Copilot extension in VS Code
2. Verify your Copilot subscription is active
3. Create a new Next.js project directory

## What You'll Learn
- How to set up GitHub Copilot
- Basic usage of Copilot in VS Code
- Understanding custom instructions

## Validation
When you're ready to proceed:
1. Create a new file called `setup-complete.md` in your repository
2. Add a comment to this issue saying "Ready for next step"

## Need Help?
- [GitHub Copilot Documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot)
